m: ā-caraṇa n. approaching, arrival (as of the dawn), RV. i, 48, 3
a: ācaraṇaṃ 1 Practising, doing, performing, following, observing; dharma˚, maṃgala˚ &c. 2 Conduct, behaviour; adhītibodhācaraṇapracāraṇaiḥ N. 1. 4 example (opp. precept); adharma˚, dur˚ &c. 3 Usage, practice. 4 An institute; rite or rule of conduct. 5 Approaching, arrival. 6 A chariot, carriage, cart.
